feeds.title: Ciente Blog
feeds.description: Ciente offers comprehensive, uninfluenced editorial coverage, market analysis, and tech insights that have immediate and far-reaching implications for business growth. It helps tech leaders be champions of change, drive meaningful results across the enterprise, and lead innovation and growth even in turbulent times. Stay updated with the latest tech news, market insights, articles, expert analysis to leverage business technology, and more.

feeds.title: StateTech Magazine » California
feeds.description: Wade through their blog and learn more about their tips, services, features, informational videos, news, events, reviews, and more. StateTech explores technology issues that state and local government IT leaders and workers face when they're evaluating and implementing a solution. It is published by CDW which is headquartered in Vernon Hills, Ill.

feeds.title: California Business Journal » Tech
feeds.description: Dive into their blog and learn more about top information on AI, data, trends and innovation, news, feature articles, business profiles, success stories, business, and more. California Business Journal magazine writes and publishes insightful, in-depth, and captivating business articles on entrepreneurs, startups, and small businesses.

feeds.title: The Mercury News » Technology
feeds.description: Explore more through their blog about the latest news related to Silicon Valley tech companies and technology trends, investors, and executives, and more. Mercury News provides you with the latest news, articles, real estate businesses, and much more.

feeds.title: California Department of Technology
feeds.description: The California Department of Technology leads the state's drive to deliver clear, fast, dependable, and equitable public services. It provides for the delivery of digital government services through the oversight of statewide IT strategic planning, project delivery, procurement, policy and standards, and enterprise architecture. Get into their blog and learn more about their services, careers, latest news, events, training, resources, project delivery, and more.

feeds.title: California Council on Science & Technology
feeds.description: California Council on Science and Technology is a non-partisan, nonprofit organization that exists to make California's policies stronger with science and technology. Established via the California State Legislature in 1988 to provide objective advice from California's scientists and research institutions. Their mission is to engage leading experts in science and technology to advise State policymakers - ensuring that California policy is strengthened and informed by scientific knowledge, research, and innovation. Explore more through their blog about news, stories, services, and more.

feeds.title: Slashdot
feeds.description: Slashdot was created in 1997 by Rob CmdrTaco Malda. Today it's owned by Slashdot Media. It is run primarily by a handful of editors and coders, with the help of many others. Check out their blog and learn more about their resources, services, stories, latest news, issues, and more.

feeds.title: Android Headlines
feeds.description: Android news and tech news websites, cover breaking news about smartphones, rumors, leaks, reviews, updates, apps, games, giveaways, deals, VR, and AI. Android Headlines works closely with Google and its partners to bring all the latest Android news, product information, and community content. Get into their blog and know the latest news, trends, updates, reviews, and much more.

feeds.title: Teacher Tech with Alice Keeler
feeds.description: Authored by Alice Keeler, a High School math teacher, Google Certified Innovator, Microsoft Innovative Educator, and Google Developer Expert. She is passionate about using technology to create student-centered classrooms. Covers 3D printing, android, apps, book reviews, coding, tablet, robotics, edtech tools, programming, chrome, and Excel. Go through her blog and learn more about services, resources, tips, articles, books, and more.

feeds.title: TechCrunch
feeds.description: TechCrunch is a leading technology media platform dedicated to profiling startups, reviewing new internet products, and breaking the latest tech news. Founded in 2005, it has established itself as a vital source of information for the tech industry. TechCrunch is spearheaded by Editor in Chief and General Manager Connie Loizos, who has a deep background in Silicon Valley journalism. The editorial team includes notable contributors like Matt Rosoff, Ingrid Lunden, Frederic Lardinois, and Kirsten Korosec, among others, who bring a wealth of experience and expertise to their respective beats.

feeds.title: VentureBeat
feeds.description: VentureBeat is the leading source for transformative tech news and events that provide deep context to help business leaders make smart decisions and stay on top of breaking news. Founded in 2006, it is recognized as the leading media authority in artificial intelligence and machine learning. It also offers the most incisive coverage of the game industry. Dive into their blog and learn more about their tips, services, AI tools, and more.

feeds.title: AppleInsider
feeds.description: AppleInsider launched in 1997 and quickly grew to become one of the Internet's premier sources of information for all things Apple. Each day you'll find the most in-depth coverage and analysis of the latest Apple rumors and insider news surrounding the company, its partners, and adversaries. Check out their blog and learn more about their services, price guides, deals, videos, reviews, podcasts, and more.

feeds.title: TechEBlog
feeds.description: TechEBlog brings you the latest technology, gadget, and geek-related news from around the world. Their commitment to combining the highest-quality products and services with the highest level of integrity in dealing with their clients and partners. Visit their blog to learn more about their services, products, news, articles, and more.

feeds.title: SiliconANGLE
feeds.description: SiliconANGLE is a modern data-driven digital media platform that creates authoritative and engaging social experiences for audiences. Covers emerging tech, cloud, AI, security, infra, blockchain, big data, apps, and IoT. They provide better editorial coverage of cloud computing, cybersecurity, AI and machine learning, modern applications and developers, blockchain and Web3, and more. Get into their blog and know more about special reports, news, services, and more.

feeds.title: UC Tech News
feeds.description: The University of California Information Technology blog informs and connects those working in the technology field at the university, along with those working closely with university technologies. About an equal portion of readers are new to the UC tech community vs long-term members of the university. Explore more through their blog about resources, jobs, latest news, events, and more.

feeds.title: InfoWorld
feeds.description: InfoWorld, the leading voice in emerging enterprise technology, is the go-to resource for developers, architects, and business leaders launching next-generation initiatives on scalable cloud platforms, where such future-focused tech as AI or machine learning, big data analytics, and NoSQL databases evolve continuously. Go through their blog and learn more about their careers, events, analytics, and more.

feeds.title: ReadWrite
feeds.description: In 2003, New Zealander Richard MacManus launched this website as ReadWriteWeb and expanded his blog on the evolving Internet into a global team of journalists. Their goal is to create the next wave of tech media firms that are committed to delivering pertinent content in a way that boosts readers' productivity. It brings together professional communities with interests in certain topics, like linked automobiles, smart homes, and more. Browse more through their blog.

feeds.title: California Institute of Arts & Technology Blog
feeds.description: California Institute of Arts and Technology is pioneering a new educational approach, beyond the traditional four-year or community college experience. Their graduates complete their programs with a portfolio of innovative experience and are uniquely positioned to compete for in-demand technology jobs. They so strongly believe in the power of integrating career preparation into your learning experience, that they'll stop at nothing to remove roadblocks for your success. Visit their blog and learn more about their programs, careers, skills, online courses, and much more.

feeds.title: UC Press Blog » Technology Studies
feeds.description: Wade through their blog and learn more about news, careers, services, products, courses, books, resources, and much more. The University of California Press is one of the most forward-thinking scholarly publishers, committed to influencing public discourse and challenging the status quo. They collaborate with faculty, librarians, authors, and students to stay ahead of today's knowledge demands. It prioritizes diversity and inclusion in all of its activities as a publisher, academic institution, employer, and member of the Bay Area community in order to further its purpose and vision.
